"Look for videos in your channels and groups?"

"Cablegram looks at the latest 100 messages in each of your channels and groups, on this phone, and counts the videos in them. It skips short clips unless you change that in Advanced settings. It does not look in personal chats or Saved Messages."

"Cablegram is signed in to Telegram on this phone, like Telegram Desktop. The code that looks at your chats lives in one place, the app.cablegram.discovery package of the phone app, and the app's open-source test (TelegramApiSurfaceTest) lists every Telegram call it is allowed to make. Chat names, counts, messages and thumbnails stay on this phone. Only the videos you add are forwarded into \"Cablegram library\"."
"One-to-one chats with people. These often hold personal videos."
